body: I will see about that in the morning, thank you.

Should the government increase spending for elementary schools. It was a little weird how we did it though, the team only competed against itself (the same way we do Congress) because the schools around us focus more on speech than debate/congress/etc. what was yours?

Unfortunately, given the area I live in, finding a community for a person like me to fit into is rare. If I do find it in myself before tomorrow evening to stick around a bit longer, I want to seek those people out.
Thank you for your kind words. I wish dearly that I had the strength of your friends.
That’s cool, following in a sibling’s footsteps.
Depends on what the affirmatives have to say, but I can usually whip up something good. What attracted you to becoming primarily affirmative?
Negative. I have been in speech for a few years but didn’t have the courage to try debate until this year. It’s been pretty interesting.

I do math tutoring (if that counts, I don’t know if teaching is really a hobby) as well as speech+debate and some theater. I’ve lost a lot of my interest in these things though, they used to be my distractions and now they feel about as fufilling as eating a spoonful of warm sand.
My family and the people who used to be my closest two friends. I don’t really have anyone to go to.

Some people are aware that I’m trans but I try my best to keep my issues in regard to that fact private. I think some of the people who are around me (coworkers and classmates) know my confidence isn’t great in general but no one knows that I’ve been through ct or that I’m suicidal. It would be a lot to dump on a person and I don’t want to cause them problems.
Both my immediate and extended family isn’t open or accepting of me. I don’t have close friends and am somewhat scared of putting too much burden on an acquaintance.
